issues.issue: The Taxes split items receipts[0]-[2] cite p4, but their amounts are printed only on the Statement of Activities (p2); p4 prints Taxes 4,344,140. The source_page should be 2. The split itself ties exactly (3,889,222 + 436,728 + 18,190 = 4,344,140).

Local is split into charges for services 391,003, interest 256,875, central communications fee 86,658, miscellaneous 126,466 and a computed residual 2,658 (receipts[5]-[9]), using Statement of Activities figures. The report prints no breakdown of Local. The SoA nets 7,411 out of both receipts and disbursements compared with p4, so it is unproven that SoA charges for services 391,003 sits wholly in Local. The split is inferred, not printed.
